content:
Last month, Anthropic announced plans to expand Claude Cowork from the Mac to iPhone and iPad. The rollout started with Anthropic’s most expensive paid plan.

As of today, Anthropic says that Claude Cowork has fully rolled out to mobile and desktop for all paid plans.

You can learn more about Anthropic’s Claude Cowork release on mobile here.

Meanwhile, OpenAI has launched its own solution called ChatGPT Work — also available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.
